summary: Match channel and review path to HCP vs DTC audiences.

sections.heading: HCP vs DTC
paragraphs: Audience determines tone, disclosures, review depth, and which channels are in scope.
bullets: HCP: professional email, CLM, congress materials, journal ads — often gated (“For US HCPs only”).
DTC: consumer digital, TV, print — different fair balance and ISI presentation rules.
Never repurpose HCP copy to consumer channels without a full review path.
